يرتضخوا (form VIII)
# يَرْتَضِخُوا (yartaḍiḵū) /jar.ta.dˤi.xuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# يُرْتَضَخُوا (yurtaḍaḵū) /jur.ta.dˤa.xuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
